description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.12

- Dedicated Official-Style About Page: Added a dedicated About page at the top of the patch settings matching Morphe's official UI design, showing version status, project overview, tested environments, source code, and one-click add-source links.
- Master Switch Dependency Cascading: Turning off the master switch automatically disables and grays out all sub-settings in Morphe settings.
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle (~30 KB): Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
